Implementation Plan

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends scripts/release_ci_gate.sh
Scope-mode justification: The issue spells out the script, where it is wired, how it is documented and how it is tested. The plan adds one standalone helper that follows the `scripts/release_ci_gate.sh` pattern: a bash script run from the release checkout with one GitHub read and a fixed log line. Both release workflows get one early step that calls it. Tests go into the existing `tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py` and reuse its helpers (`_top_level_job_block`, `_step_block`, `_clean_bash_environment`). There is one addition the issue does not list: `docs/INVENTORY.md`. `tests/inventory_parity.py`, which CI runs, fails when a file under `scripts/` is missing from that inventory, so adding the script without the entry would turn CI red. Under the Boil the Lake rule I also include a small "publishing is off" skip (D3, about 10 lines). It reads the same two switches the release job reads, so the preflight cannot fail a run that will never push a tag.

## Automation / scheduling (§20.E)
- **Script type:** one new helper, `scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh`. It is not a manual script. It runs automatically inside the existing release workflows.
- **Entry points:**
  - `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, job `resolve-version`, triggered by `workflow_dispatch` from `auto-release-stable.yml` / the promote cycle.
  - `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml`, job `resolve-version`, triggered by `workflow_dispatch`.
- **Long-running supervisor:** none needed.
- **DB work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry. This is a permanent pipeline helper, not a single-use, long-running or supervisor script.

PLANNING REF CONTEXT: HEAD `854fcb008536a927fa27fa5d94a82efdfb647952` on `orchestrator/project-7713` (integration branch metadata matches; mismatch=false). The prerequisite rejection-classification work is already on this ref: `agents.d/wfopt-0922-release-tag-rejection.md` exists, and both workflows carry `RELEASE_TAG_PUBLISH ... error_class=workflow_scope` in `publish_tag_with_remote_verification`.

## Files likely to change
- `scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh` (new, mode 0755)
- `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`
- `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml`
- `tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py`
- `agents.d/wfopt-0922-release-tag-preflight.md` (new)
- `changelog.d/wfopt-0922-release-tag-preflight.md` (new)
- `docs/INVENTORY.md` (one added `scripts/` bullet; CI's inventory parity gate requires it)

## Functions or modules to implement

### 1. `scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh` (tabs, `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, `set -uo pipefail`)
The header comment names the source (Speed #4 / Reliability #2 of `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-22.md`, run 35639756385). It also explains why the script introspects the credential instead of pushing:
- `git push --dry-run` does not reach GitHub's server-side permission checks.
- A temporary tag push would be a mutation.

It carries a §14 comment above the API call:
> One `GET /user` call (`gh api -i user`). No existing call in `source` or `resolve-version` returns response headers. The `X-OAuth-Scopes` header is the only place a classic PAT reports its scopes, so no existing call can be reused.

**Inputs (env), all with defaults (§8):**
- `GH_TOKEN`: the workflow passes `secrets.GH_PAT` only, never `github.token`.
- `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED`: default on.
- `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_BASE_SHA`: commit of the current `stable` tag.
- `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_HEAD_SHA`: commit being released.
- `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED` / `RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED`: default `true`. Both are parsed the way the release job parses them.
- Optional `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_GIT_DIR`, default `.`, so tests can point the script at a scratch repo.

**Helper functions (names checked unique within the new file):**
- `release_tag_preflight_emit <result> <error_class> <reason>`: prints exactly `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT result=<r> error_class=<c> reason=<token>`.
- `release_tag_preflight_switch_on <raw>`: returns 0 when the value is unset, empty or `true` (case-insensitive), 1 when it is `false`. Any other value also returns 1 and prints a `::warning::` that does not echo the value.
- `release_tag_preflight_header_scopes <headers_file>`: reads the header block up to the first blank line, strips `\r`, matches `x-oauth-scopes:` case-insensitively and prints the value. It returns 2 when the header is absent.

**Decision order** (each outcome exits 0 unless stated):

| Order | Condition | Output | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Switch off | `result=skipped error_class=none reason=disabled` (`reason=invalid_switch` plus a warning for an unknown value) | 0 |
| 2 | `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED` or `RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED` off | `result=skipped error_class=none reason=publishing_disabled` | 0 |
| 3 | Empty `GH_TOKEN` | `result=unknown error_class=none reason=gh_pat_missing` | 0 |
| 4 | Base or head not `^[0-9a-f]{40}$` | `result=unknown ... reason=invalid_range` | 0 |
| 5 | Any of: `gh api -i user` fails (`reason=api_failed`), header missing (`reason=no_scope_header`: fine-grained PAT or App token), `git diff --name-only <base>..<head>` fails (`reason=git_failed`) | `result=unknown ...` | 0 |
| 6 | The scopes contain exactly `workflow` after splitting on `,` and trimming | `result=pass error_class=none reason=workflow_scope_present` | 0 |
| 7 | No changed path starts with `.github/workflows/` | `result=pass error_class=none reason=no_workflow_changes` | 0 |
| 8 | Otherwise | `result=fail error_class=workflow_scope reason=classic_pat_missing_workflow_scope`, plus one `::error::` with remediation | 1 |

The remediation in step 8 tells the operator to:
- give `GH_PAT` the `workflow` scope (classic PAT), or switch to a fine-grained PAT / GitHub App with `workflows: write`;
- then re-run the release.

It also gives the count of changed workflow files, without listing names or printing token or header values. `mktemp` under `${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}` holds the header file, and an EXIT trap removes it. Stderr from `gh` goes to `/dev/null` (or a temp file that is never printed), so no response body or token reaches the log. The script must never print the token or any header other than the scope value. Only the yes/no decision is logged; the scope string is not.

### 2. Workflow wiring (both files)
A new step `Preflight release tag credential` (id `release_tag_preflight`) goes into the `resolve-version` job, directly after `Resolve version tag`:
- That job already has a `fetch-depth: 0` checkout with `fetch-tags: true` of the commit being released: `github.sha` in test-and-mark-stable, the source branch in mark-stable.
- The release job `needs: resolve-version` in both files, so a failure here skips release, and in test-and-mark-stable it also skips every e2e job, all of which `needs: [resolve-version]`.
- The `source` job is deliberately not used. Its comment says it "runs no repository code".

**`if:`**
- test-and-mark-stable: `${{ !inputs.dry_run && !inputs.gate_only }}`. A gate_only run skips release, see line 6392.
- mark-stable: `${{ !inputs.dry_run }}`.

**`env:`** (every `${{ }}` value goes through `env:`):
- `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`
- `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED: ${{ vars.RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED || 'true' }}`
- `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED: ${{ vars.STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED || 'true' }}`
- `RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED: ${{ vars.RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED || 'true' }}`

**`run:` body, byte-identical in both workflows** (a test checks this):
1. `base="$(git rev-parse -q --verify 'refs/tags/stable^{commit}' 2>/dev/null || true)"`
2. `head="$(git rev-parse -q --verify 'HEAD^{commit}' 2>/dev/null || true)"`
3. If `scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh` is not a regular file, print `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT result=unknown error_class=none reason=script_missing` with a `::warning::` and exit 0 (fail open).
4. Otherwise run `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_BASE_SHA="$base" RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_HEAD_SHA="$head" bash scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh`.

The step does not set `continue-on-error`, so exit 1 fails the job. After editing, check `wc -c`: test-and-mark-stable is 426,590 bytes today and about 1.5 KB is added, which stays under the 480,000-byte guard; mark-stable is about 79 KB.

### 3. `agents.d/wfopt-0922-release-tag-preflight.md`
Two blocks:
- `<!-- agents: section="Stable log prefixes (contractual)" -->`:
  - a `` - `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT` `` bullet giving the location (`resolve-version` step in both release workflows), the fields `result=pass|fail|unknown|skipped error_class=workflow_scope|none reason=<token>` and the reason vocabulary;
  - the line `LOG_PREFIX.name=RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT`.
- A second block under an existing section, `<!-- agents: section="Immutable consumer wrapper pins" -->`, where the release-switch bullets live. It documents:
  - the switch `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED` (default on; `false` off; any other value off with a warning);
  - the fail-only-when rule;
  - the fact that every uncertain case proceeds.

`agents.md` itself is not edited (§25).

### 4. `changelog.d/wfopt-0922-release-tag-preflight.md`
A user-facing entry in the §20 fragment format.

### 5. `docs/INVENTORY.md`
One bullet under Scripts next to `release_ci_gate.sh`:
`` - `scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh` — Early release-credential check: fail when a classic GH_PAT lacks `workflow` scope and the release range changes workflows (log prefix `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT`). ``

## Data structures affected
None persistent. The only new data is the log line contract `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT result=… error_class=… reason=…`.

## API or interface changes
- New optional repository variable `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED`, default on.
- New log prefix `RELEASE_TAG_PREFLIGHT`.
- No new workflow inputs or outputs. Existing identifiers are unchanged.
